items.statement: The submission identifies both named inputs as 57-atom neutral singlet single-arm conformers and supplies auditable validation.
items.expected: Both structures, charge 0, multiplicity 1, atom count and calculation status are explicit.

items.statement: The calculation establishes the lowest singlet transition and assigns its dominant orbital character.
items.expected: S1 is explicitly identified and predominantly HOMO→LUMO character is reported for the single-arm model.

items.statement: The cisoid S0→S1 excitation is lower than the transoid excitation by the source-reported relative amount.
items.expected: Signed cisoid-minus-transoid shift is approximately -0.08 eV.
